abstract: The measurement system based on PXI bus is developed to accomplish the accurate measurement of model angle, aerodynamic force and flow field parameters for angle of attack sweeping aerodynamic force test. Magnetic grid and impulse register technology are applied in model angle measurement by converting the impulse number to angle. DAQ card is adopted to finish force, pressure and temperature measurement. The system software possess the good qualities of perfect function and convenient operation. The measurement system entirely fulfils the requirements of acquiring signal, analysing data and process data for attack sweeping aerodynamic force test.

articleTitle: A novel approach for solving the Van Der Pol equation
publicationTitle: 2019 12th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: We transform the second ordinary differential Van Der Pol equation into the first order differential equation system. By this system, we construct an unconstraint optimization problem. Moreover, we give a Rounge-Kutta based Bat algorithm to solve this optimization problem. The numerical experiment shows that the given algorithm solves the optimization effectively.

articleTitle: Case Reasoning Research of Emergency Network Opinion Based on Ontology
publicationTitle: 2019 12th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: This paper introduces the construction process of the emergency network opinion case library. It uses ontology as the basic rule of knowledge representation and knowledge reasoning, it analyzes the field of emergency network opinion, and obtains the ontology model of emergency network opinion case. This paper discusses the process of case reasoning and the main method of case retrieval. It obtains the weighted sum of attribute similarity according to the categories of attributes, and realizes the application test of case reasoning of the emergency network opinion. (Abstract)

articleTitle: Research on Battery State Tracking and Remaining Life Prediction Method Based on Improved Particle Filtering and Reformed Self-Adaptive Fusion Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2019 12th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: In this paper, based on the Bayesian state tracking training updating proposed distribution method to improve particle degradation phenomenon, the superior characteristics of Markov Chain-Monte Carlo theory (MCMC) is fully used to enrich the diversity of sampling particles to solve the problem of resampling depletion, and build an updated and improved particle filtering (PF) algorithmic research model based on MCMC to predict the remaining useful life (RUL) of battery. Meanwhile, the method of combining reformed self-adaptive algorithm with updated and improved PF algorithmic research model is adopted to identify and optimize the noise multi-feature parameters of different experimental data, then obtain the identification table of process noise distribution. Based on the above analysis, an integrate system of systematic research methods for self-adaptive identification noise distribution, battery state tracking and RUL prediction is proposed in this paper. The analysis results show that the system has the advantages of good fitting degree of state tracking, high RUL prediction accuracy (error less than 5%) and strong stability, robustness and generalization adaptability.

articleTitle: Research on Dynamic Wireless Charging Control Strategy of Electric Vehicle Based on Photoelectric Detection and Location
publicationTitle: 2019 12th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: This paper focuses on the research of a piecewise structure of electric vehicle road dynamic wireless charging method, which uses multiple transmitting coils at the transmitter to realize the wireless power supply for the running electric vehicle. Based on the structure of dynamic wireless charging system of electric vehicle with magnetically coupled resonance, the equivalent circuit theory is used to model and analyze the system. A method of receiving end location based on photoelectric detection is proposed. The receiving end position is determined by photoelectric diffuse reflectance sensor, and then the transmitting coil of corresponding position is opened to realize receiving. Real-time charging. Maxwell and Simulink software are used to verify and analyze the system. The magnetic field distribution law of the system using positioning control is determined, and the feasibility of the positioning control method is proved.

articleTitle: Fault Diagnosis of Hydroelectric Sets Based on Singular Value Decomposition and Deep Belief Network
publicationTitle: 2019 12th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Aiming at the strong nonlinearity and nonstationary features of hydroelectric sets vibration fault signal, a vibration fault diagnosis method on the basis of singular value decomposition (SVD) and deep belief network (DBN) for hydroelectric sets is put forward. Firstly, the phase space is reconstructed from the vibration signal to obtain the feature matrix; Secondly, the SVD is performed on the feature matrix, and the singular value sequence with the fault feature is selected by the preferred difference spectrum method to achieve the purpose of noise reduction; Finally, a DBN classifier model is established to realize fault diagnosis of hydroelectric sets. The experimental verification by the actual hydroelectric sets fault data shows that the fault types of the hydroelectric sets can be effectively diagnose according to this new method.

articleTitle: The Study and Design of Control System of Distribution Network Operation Robot
publicationTitle: 2019 12th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Aiming at the high risk degree of manual lapping or replacement of distribution network drainage lines, this paper designs a control system of distribution network operation robot based on STM32 and TMS320.The robot adopts the “master-slave” topology that The master controller (STM32F407IGT6) sends commands to the mechanical arm controller (TMS320F28335) through the serial port, and then the mechanical arm controller controls the corresponding motor motion through CAN communication, so as to realize the operation of the mechanical arm. At the same time, the upper computer monitoring interface is written with C# language, which can monitor the motion state of the robot in real time, and modify the motor joint parameters and storage of the robot in real time. The test shows that the robot controlled by this system can realize the task of distribution network better.

articleTitle: Bottom-up simplied RefineNet for human clothing estimation
publicationTitle: 2019 12th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: With the development of economy and the upgrading concept of people's consumption, the market potential of fashion industry has been tapped greatly. More attention has been paid to garment analysis. However, the machine analysis of clothes is vulnerable to the influence of scale and deformation. In this paper, we present an algorithm of locating key points of women's clothing based on human posture estimation technology. By transferring human posture estimation technology to this application, the algorithm can not only help overcome the above influences, but also promote the improvement of the effects of position alignment, local attribute recognition and automatic editing of clothing image. The innovation points of this paper are summarized as follows: firstly, in the coding stage, the bottom-up path enhancement method is adopted to improve the feature fusion ability of the coding structure of the basic network; secondly, in the decoding stage, simplifying the RefineNet structure of CPN network improves the accuracy while increasing the speed; thirdly, Integral regression method is used in this paper, which combined the advantages of heatmap and key points regression. Extensive experiment results show that the proposed algorithm can outperform CPN in COCO database.

articleTitle: Blind Detection of Stationary Signals and Periodic Stationary Signals
publicationTitle: 2019 12th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: A blind detection method based on power spectrum and cyclic spectrum is adopted for the blind detection of stationary signals and periodic stationary signals. This method can accurately determine the existence of a stationary signal. This paper is mainly for Gaussian signals. Firstly, the power spectrum is used for the stationary signal detection. Then, the presence of the to-be-identified signal is detected by the difference between the periodic stationary signal and the Gaussian white noise. The experimental simulation of the detection method shows that the recognition rate of most modulation types can reach about 90% when the signal-to-noise ratio is greater than -10dB, which verifies the effectiveness of the method.

articleTitle: Optimization Clustering Algorithm Based on Multi-factor Improved SEP in WSN
publicationTitle: 2019 12th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Stable Election Protocol(SEP) algorithm is often used to divide the sensors into clusters in Wireless Sensor Network(WSN).This paper proposes an improved SEP protocol that can divide cluster by comprehensively considering the influence of remaining energy, signal strength, and distribution density on WSN energy consumption. It can be proved by the exprimental results that the method can effectively save the power and extend the usage time of WSNs.

articleTitle: Double Hidden Layer Neural Network for Bearing Fault Detection Using Pre-Extracted Optimal Features
publicationTitle: 2019 12th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Bearing is one of the key components in mechanical system, which influences the operation quality and service life of the whole system. However, in practice, bearings are easily damaged and can cause serious consequences. It is important to diagnose the latent early bearing faults and make necessary repairing. Vibration signal detection method is one the most efficient ways for early bearing fault diagnosing. Raw vibration signal data can be collected through the detection sensor and classified by various signal processing methods or pattern recognition methods. We firstly extract the features of the data manually using prior knowledge and select the optimal feature vector. Then we independently construct a double hidden layer fully-connected neural network to classify the latent bearing fault and compare it with several supervised learning algorithms. After training, the accuracy of the test data set reaches 100%*.

articleTitle: Regulatory Element Parallel Mining Algorithm Based on Bit Combination
publicationTitle: 2019 12th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Regulatory element parallel mining algorithm of frequent itemset based on bit combination is proposed in this paper. The algorithm is represented by converting promoter data filtered by frequent itemset into binary machine bits, and then mining the frequent itemset of the data set in parallel by means of regulatory element. In the whole mining process, if a combination of regulatory elements is frequent, data should be added 1, and if it is not frequent, the data should be pruned. Preprocessing, eliminating and other operations are used to optimize the whole algorithm. Converting the processed raw data and regulatory element into binary bits facilitates the parallel operation of data and saves memory space, breaking through the limitations of traditional methods that cannot be effectively parallelized due to recursive operations in the mining process. In this thesis, OpenMP technology is used to parallelize the algorithm based on regulatory element, which improves the efficiency of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Research on Model for Sensory Quality of Yoghurt Based on Stacking
publicationTitle: 2019 12th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Yoghurt is a delicious, nutritious and healthy dairy product. How to quickly and accurately identify the sensory quality of yoghurt is of great significance to the control of sensory quality of yoghurt. In this paper, sensor data of 120 yoghurt samples were obtained by electronic nose, and the measured sensor data were used as inputs to construct kNearest Neighbors(kNN) and Support Vector Machine(SVM) base classifiers. Then the Stacking method was employed to integrate the base classifiers, which constructed the sensory quality classification model for yoghurt. The comparative experiment showed that the sensory quality classification model based on Stacking algorithm has better accuracy and generalizability than the single models based on kNN and SVM.

articleTitle: Functional Study of Graphene Composite Fiber Seamless Knitted Fabric
publicationTitle: 2019 12th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: In this paper, graphene nylon and graphene nylon wrapped yarn are applied to seamless knitted products, and the functional properties of graphene composite fiber seamless knitted fabrics are studied, which provides a reference for the popularization and development of graphene composite fiber seamless knitted fabrics. According to the seamless knitting technology, this paper sets up three influencing factors: veil materials, lining materials and weave structures. By using the orthogonal method, 9 pieces of graphene composite fiber seamless knitted fabric samples were weaved. Orthogonal analysis of the effect of three factors on the far-infrared, antistatic and anti-ultraviolet properties of fabrics is carried out.

articleTitle: On the Succinctness of Cardinality Constraint Programs and Simple Definite Causal Theories
publicationTitle: 2019 12th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: In this paper, we prove that every polynomial-size theory in simple definite causal theories (STry) can be equivalently translated into a cardinality constraint program (CPing) with small-size growth(without introducing new variables). It is well known that the PARITY problem can be represented by a polynomial-size CPing program but exponential-size blowup is inevitable in STry, we get the conclusion that CPing is more succinct than STry. The result gives us a deeper understanding about the succinctness relationships between different classes of logic formalisms.

articleTitle: Road rage influencing factors research based on the digital news text analysis
publicationTitle: 2019 12th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: This paper was based on digital news text analysis to study the influencing factors of road rage, instead of traditional simulation experiments or questionnaire survey methods. About 167 reports of road rage incident were collected from the website, further being processed into visual charts as well as statistical analysis. Finally came to the conclusion that road rage had a significant relationship with time, area, gender, vehicle characteristics, etc.

articleTitle: The effect of road environment and type of vehicles on road rage in China
publicationTitle: 2019 12th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Road rage has a series of adverse effects on driving safety, and many accidents caused by road rage occur in China. Thus, understanding the pattern of road rage has great significance to driving safety. In the present study, 33 video news was evaluated subjectively on the severity of road rage and environmental variables, the gender of drivers and the dimension of inducing events were coded according to the video. The results revealed that the road rage was more serious when the number of lanes was lower, and the rage vehicle and offensive vehicle were non-motorized vehicles. There were more cars and fewer non-motor vehicles in road rage during the daytime and fewer angry trucks in the urban areas. On the highway, the vehicles in rage involve more trucks and fewer cars. Moreover, drivers of cars were more likely to do discourteous offensive behavior and drivers of the non-motor vehicles were more likely to do slow-driving behavior. These findings can be applied to the design of intelligent transportation systems and the education of drivers to relieve road rage.

articleTitle: Gait analysis based on angular velocity during human walking on five terrains
publicationTitle: 2019 12th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Gait analysis is the systematic study of human locomotion from the perspective of biology and kinematic. This work investigates the relationship between motion of feet and plantar pressure during human walking on five different types of terrains typical of daily living. Temporal parameters and symmetry index of gaits are calculated by method based on angular velocity of coronal axis. The results show gait features on different terrain and subject have commonness and differences.

articleTitle: Beam search algorithm based on dynamic cutting
publicationTitle: 2019 12th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: In this paper, a two-dimensional staged cutting problem is studied. It is required to cut a plurality of sheet materials containing defects into small rectangular blocks of a predetermined size in a guillotine method, and the finished product cannot contain defects. In order to solve the above problems, a beam search algorithm based on dynamic cutting is proposed. The algorithm splits the problem into multiple local rectangular cutting problems. The blanks are cut out in the first stage, and each area is solved by beam search. The action selection rules with the margins as indicators are defined and operated one by one. The current local area cannot cut any small rectangular block, and the strategy is made “flexible” by presetting the cutting line. Solving the local optimum and then achieving the global optimal goal. The experiment uses the official A group of examples to compare and analyze the current optimal solution of each study. When the algorithm deals with the large size difference between the small rectangular block and the sheet material, the utilization rate of the example plate can reach 80%.

articleTitle: Application of Gray Discrete Bi-level Linear Programming Model in the Double Emergency Management Network
publicationTitle: 2019 12th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Based on the consideration of respective and common interests of emergency management network decision-making departments and the affected people, the gray discrete bi-level programming method, is applied to solve the double emergency management network planning problem with interval gray parameters. A related model is established to simulate and optimize the design of the medical rescue supplies dispatch management network under the condition of sudden infectious diseases. The gray discrete bi-level programming method based on the hierarchical model and solution, fully considering the hierarchical level of the management system and the selection behavior of the affected people, can be used to solve the planning problem of the emergency management network with interval gray parameters, and optimize the decision-making mechanism of the actual management network. It is proved that calculation results are more credible compared with other traditional planning models.

articleTitle: A direct numerical method for solving the Föppl-Hencky equation
publicationTitle: 2019 12th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: We rewrite the Föppl-Hencky equation as an unconstrained optimization, and then solve the equation by an optimization algorithm. The optimization algorithm is constructed by combining the intelligent algorithms with an numerical algorithm for different equation. We give three numerical experiments, and the simulation results show that the Rounge-Kutta method based particle swarm optimization algorithm solves the equation very well.

articleTitle: Application Study of Virtual Simulation Experiment in Teaching of Logistics System Planning and Design
publicationTitle: 2019 12th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: The construction of the virtual simulation experimental teaching projects is the work promoted during the “13th Five-Year Plan” period Through the investigation to understand the current situation of shared bicycles and various factors affecting the development of shared bicycles, Virtual simulation experiment is used to model and simulate its system, find out the problems and hidden dangers, and then compare the optimization schemes to provide the optimal improvement strategy. To the appropriate department, maintain the stability of the supply chain system so that it can operate efficiently and continuously. The course pushes forward the overall improvement of the quality of education and teaching and the talent training.

articleTitle: Manifold Smoothed Class-specific Discriminant Collaborative Representation for Face Recognition
publicationTitle: 2019 12th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Representation based classifications are extensively used in many applications and have achieved remarkable successes. However, they still suffer from some problems. In one respect, the coefficients obtained are not competitive, which is not beneficial for classification. Also, the intrinsic manifold structure is not taken into consideration. It has been shown that the manifold smoothness is important for classification. To this end, based on collaborative representation, a new algorithm coined Manifold Smoothed Class-specific Discriminant Collaborative Representation, MSCDCR, for short, is proposed. Besides manifold structure, MSCDCR employs the whole training samples to code the test sample in a linear way, so that it can tell which class has the most similarity. The method proposed can reduced to a closed-form solution, which is time-efficient, and it also can exploit the intrinsic manifold geometric structure and discriminant information. Consequently, it bears more discriminant ability. Experiments are carried out on face recognition, and they show the relatively promising performance of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Ontology Based Security Risk Model for Power Terminal Equipment
publicationTitle: 2019 12th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: IoT based technology are drastically accelerating the informationization development of the power grid system of China that consists of a huge number of power terminal devices interconnected by the network of electric power IoT. However, the networked power terminal equipment oriented cyberspace security has continually become a challenging problem as network attack is continually varying and evolving. In this paper, we concentrate on the security risk of power terminal equipment and their vulnerability based on ATP attack detection and defense. We first analyze the attack mechanism of APT security attack based on power terminal equipment. Based on the analysis of the security and attack of power IoT terminal device, an ontology-based knowledge representation method of power terminal device and its vulnerability is proposed.

articleTitle: Research on the Thermal-Wet Comfort Performance for the Knitting Sports Shoes
publicationTitle: 2019 12th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: The thermal and moisture comfort of knitted fabrics is an important indicator that must be studied. It is related to the regulation of the heat and humidity of the human body by the knitted fabric. Its thermal comfort performance is mainly determined by the air content in the fabric, the density of the air, the static and active state of the air, its wet comfort performance is mainly manifested in the human body in a high temperature and high humidity environment or the human body to perform vigorous activities, and the skin surface and the outside world The ability of the fabric to absorb moisture, dissipate moisture or conduct moisture and convect and dehumidify when there is a humidity gradient in the environment [1]. Based on the above research, this paper comprehensively evaluate the thermal and moisture comfort of knitted fabrics by testing the thermal insulation, moisture permeability, air permeability and wicking ability of fabrics of different tissue structures.

articleTitle: The Impact of Trade Facilitation Level of G20 Countries on China’s Services Export
publicationTitle: 2019 12th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Based on the research ideas of Wilson, Mann and Otsuki (2003), a comprehensive index system for measuring the level of trade facilitation is constructed, which includes four first-level indicators and eleven second-level indicators. Taking the trade data of G20 countries from 2010 to 2015 as sample space, the trade facilitation level of G20 countries is calculated, and it is empirically analyzed by using the expanded trade gravity model that the impact of facilitation level of G20 countries on China's service industry exports. The empirical results show that the level of trade facilitation, GDP, territorial area, geographical distance and population size of G20 countries are important factors affecting China's service export to G20 countries. On this basis, the impact of the firstlevel indicators of trade facilitation on China's services exports is analyzed. It is found that the E-commerce coefficient has the greatest impact, followed by customs management, infrastructure and institutional environment. After changing the weights of each level of indicators of trade facilitation level in G20 countries, the conclusion is still robust.

articleTitle: High speed collision localization based on surface vibration processing
publicationTitle: 2019 12th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: High speed or ultra-high speed collision localizations have been found wide applications in many fields, such as the protection of manned spacecraft, robots, vehicles, ships, machine tool collision damage detection and localizations, etc. In this paper, we develop a high speed collision detection and localization algorithm based on discrete wavelet transform (DWT) and kernel extreme learning machine (KELM). The collision localization is finally achieved using the estimated distances of multiple joint sensors. To validate the effectiveness of the proposed method, real vibrations collected from the collisions generated by three kinds of high speed bullets striking on the aluminium alloy plate are employed for experiments.

articleTitle: A novel robust facial expression recognition approach
publicationTitle: 2019 12th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: At present, the method of facial expression recognition is put forward in many applications. In these applications, the responsiveness and robustness of the system is very important, especially the robustness is crucial. In this paper, a method of facial expression recognition based on robust minimax probability machine(RMPM) is proposed. By simply modifying the input data to improve the robustness of the estimation error in the mean and covariance matrix, we can ensure that the accuracy of the test set (TSA) is always greater than the low estimation bound of RMPM. Experiments show that the recognition method based on RMPM is better than that based on MPM.

articleTitle: A New Two-Step Method for Damage Identification in Beam Type Structure
publicationTitle: 2019 12th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: A two-step method based on the difference of normalized strain mode combined with BP neural network for damage identification of cantilever structure is presented in this paper. The number and location of the crack is identified from the difference between the normalized strain mode of the intact and cracked beams in the first step. Then, the structural damage degree is identified using BP neural network. To verify the effectiveness and efficiency of the two-step method in this paper, the simulation model of the cantilever beam structure is established using MATLAB software. Both single crack and double cracks recognition are simulated, the damage identification result is compared with the transfer matrix method. Compared with transfer matrix equation method, the two-step method presented in this paper has higher recognition accuracy and lower computational cost. After that, the damage identification experiments of single crack and double crack aluminum alloy cantilever structure based on PVDF sensors array were conducted. Simulation and experimental results showed that the proposed two-step method in this paper is versatile for both single crack and multiple cracks identification.

articleTitle: Study on the Appearance and Mechanical Properties of Mulberry Silk Knitted Fabric
publicationTitle: 2019 12th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: This paper mainly studies the relationship between backing yarn specification, surface yarn specification, fabric structure, appearance and mechanical performance of 18 silk seamless knitted fabrics. By testing the appearance and mechanical performance of the fabrics, the comprehensive evaluation of these performance is carried out by using the method of fuzzy mathematics, and the optimized technological parameters of the fabric structure are obtained, which provides a certain basis for the design and development of new seamless knitted fabrics.

articleTitle: Improvement of SEP Protocol Based on Energy Consumption and Residual Energy
publicationTitle: 2019 12th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: In order to prolong the service life and improve the performance of wireless sensor networks, this paper proposes an improved routing protocol (RR-SEP) based on the Stable Election Protocol. In the improved protocol, the two factors of node energy consumption and residual energy are considered comprehensively. In the two-level heterogeneous network, the RR-SEP protocol combines the effects of node energy consumption and residual energy with the cluster head election mechanism in the traditional SEP protocol. The comparison between RR-SEP and SEP protocol shows that RR-SEP can balance energy usage better, extend network life cycle, and has better performance in network stability.

articleTitle: Optimum Design of Fractional Order PID Controller for a Servo System Using Hybrid Intelligent Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 12th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: As servo control system is applied more and more widely in engineering, its response speed, tracking accuracy and adaptability to complex environment have higher requirements. In order to achieve these goals, this paper proposes an improved Chicken Swarm-Particle Swarm hybrid algorithm and applies it to the parameter tuning of fractional-order PID, that is, to obtain the optimal parameters through global search, and then to complete the design of the optimal FOPID controller. Compared with the other three intelligent optimization algorithms, the simulation results show that the SCPSO optimized FOPID controller has better response performance, anti-interference ability and robustness.

Author Keywords: genetic algorithm based on the State-space

articleTitle: On the Succinctness of Cardinality Constraint Programs and Canonical Logic Programs
publicationTitle: 2019 12th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: In this paper, we will discuss the succinctness between cardinality constraint programs (CPing) and canonical logic programs (Ping). We prove that every Ping program has an equivalent translation in CPing with small-size growth(without new variables). It is well known that the PARITY problem can be represented by a polynomial-size CPing program while exponential-size blowup is inevitable in Ping programs(without new variables). we get the conclusion that CPing is more succinct than Ping.

articleTitle: A Densely Connected Transformer for Machine Translation
publicationTitle: 2019 12th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Recent work has shown that the network for natural language processing (NLP) task can be deeper as well as more accurate by applying attention mechanism with residual. However, the original features of training data will be lost after multiple operations on deep network. We propose a new model structure, Densely Connected Transformer (DCT), which is based on the Transformer to solve this problem. We connect each encoder/decoder layer to other layers, and sum outputs of all previous layers as the input of next layer. Our model encourages feature reuse and improves the information flow between layers. We apply this model to machine translation (MT) tasks and evaluate it on both IWSLT 2016 German-English and IWSLT 2016 German-English. The experiment results show that our model obtains a higher BLEU scores than the basic Transformer after training for 20 epochs. And the convergence speed of our model is faster than the basic Transformer.

articleTitle: The Effects of Rewards Mechanisms On the Game-based Chinese Learning System
publicationTitle: 2019 12th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Gamification can help students to learn. However, different mechanisms of gamification have different effects, especially the rewards mechanisms. Thus, this study aims to investigate the effects of rewards mechanisms on the gamebased Chinese learning system. We defined 2 kinds of rewards mechanisms: intrinsic and extrinsic rewards based on selfdetermination theory, and conduct an experiment in 3 version of game-based Chinese learning system to find out how rewards mechanisms affect users' learning motivation and behavior intention to keep learning in the game-based Chinese learning system. The results reveal that intrinsic-rewards are mostly lead to higher motivation and behavior intention to keep learning. Further, extrinsic-rewards have slight effects on users' motivation, but it has no significant effect on users' behavior intention to keep learning. These insights add relevant findings to the ongoing discourse on the roles of different types of rewards mechanisms in gamification designs and suggest that learning system designers and operators should value the intrinsic motivation in users' behavior.

articleTitle: Research Progress and Development Trend Evolution of Recommendation System
publicationTitle: 2019 12th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Based on CNKI and Web of Science, this paper uses the methods of bibliometric, social network analysis, Co-word Analysis and data visualization to analyze the trends in the volume of publications, the organization, high-frequency keywords and their relevance, and explore the research hotspots and development trends in this field. Through the analysis of the development process of foreign research, we can find the change in international influence of domestic research.

articleTitle: Research on Rice Evaluation Method Based on Multi-feature Fusion of Cross-media
publicationTitle: 2019 12th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: For most rice, it is based on the classification of pictures alone, and it is not suitable for the evaluation of rice products on e-commerce website platform. A rice evaluation method based on cross-media is proposed. The two sets of feature vectors extracted from rice images and rice reviews were used to study the fusion classification. Firstly, the outline features of rice images and the feature word vectors of rice reviews were extracted, and then the two sets of vectors were merged by using typical correlation analysis. The merged features are standardized, and the random forest is used as a classifier to learn. Finally, a rice evaluation method based on cross-media multi-feature fusion is realized. By learning and testing the rice on the e-commerce website, the proposed method achieves 90% accuracy, compared to the random forest under multi-features and the KNN under the multi-features, and the tree classifier. High accuracy.

articleTitle: AHFNet: Aggregation of Hierarchical Features for Crowd Counting
publicationTitle: 2019 12th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Accurately estimating crowds is a particularly tricky problem for public safety. In this paper, we propose a pyramid network called AHFNet (aggregation of hierarchical features network) to effectively overcome this challenge. Different convolution layers extract rich features, which are then aggregated to generate useful crowd density maps. To further improve the method's performances, we also introduce a unique technique named PVBS (projection variance and background suppression) to obtain more effective labels. In the PVBS, the projection relation of people is considered to estimate variance of Gaussian kernels in the ground truths, and the background pixels are set to a negative value directly. Extensive experiments are conducted on the ShanghaiTech dataset, and the results demonstrate our method outperforms those state-of-the-art methods in terms of crowd counting accuracy, which shows that our method has greater practical potential.

articleTitle: Comparison of Location Privacy Protection Schemes in VANETs
publicationTitle: 2019 12th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Vehicular Ad-hoc Networks (VANETs) is a traditional mobile ad hoc network (MANET) used on traffic roads and it is a special mobile ad hoc network. As an intelligent transportation system, VANETs can solve driving safety and provide value-added services. Therefore, the application of VANETs can improve the safety and efficiency of road traffic. Location services are in a crucial position for the development of VANETs. VANETs has the characteristics of open access and wireless communication. Malicious node attacks may lead to the leakage of user privacy in VANETs, thus seriously affecting the use of VANETs. Therefore, the location privacy issue of VANETs cannot be ignored. This paper classifies the attack methods in VANETs, and summarizes and compares the location privacy protection techniques proposed in the existing research.

articleTitle: Multi-Level Creation of Fuzzy Ensembles through Diversified Settings of Parameters
publicationTitle: 2019 12th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Due to the presence of shades of grey in reality, the fuzzy set theory has been popularly used for dealing with real-life classification problems in the setting of machine learning. In particular, fuzzy rule-based systems are trained using real-life data for classifying new instances that involve fuzziness, impression and uncertainty. Traditional approaches have been typically designed to produce fuzzy rule-based systems in a specific setting of parameters (e.g., t-norm and t-conorm). However, the same setting of parameters would usually lead to the production of fuzzy systems that show varied performance on different data sets. In order to keep the performance more stable and consistently good enough, in this paper, we propose a fuzzy rule ensemble approach that involves multi-level diversity creation through diversified settings of parameters, e.g., diversified use of features and heuristics for training of fuzzy rule-based classifiers. The experimental results indicate that the fuzzy classification performance is advanced on multiple data sets through adopting our proposed approach, in comparison with other approaches of training single fuzzy rule-based classifiers and creating fuzzy ensembles.

articleTitle: Application Research of Servo Circuit Based on PLC and Configuration Software
publicationTitle: 2019 12th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: This paper mainly designs an AC servo system based on PLC and configuration software. This AC servo system uses the position control mode of the servo amplifier. Based on the position control mode, this paper has discussed how to use the high-speed pulse output function of the S7-200 PLC to control the servo motor in detail. The touch screen is used as the interactive interface in the system, and the servo motor can be controlled in positioning control mode and jog control mode by the touch screen. In the positioning control mode, the forward rotation positioning, forward rotation speed regulation, reverse rotation positioning and reverse speed regulation of the servo motor can be realized separately. In the jog control, the servo motor can rotate at a fixed speed.

articleTitle: Design of digital Control High-voltage DC Power Supply
publicationTitle: 2019 12th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: In order to detect electro-osmosis flow conveniently, a digital small-power high-voltage DC (HDC) power supply based on DSP is introduced which is fully controllable and fast response. The structure of the main circuit is Buck converter which is controlled by the voltage PWM control technology. A voltage feedback closed loop is used in the circuit, in which the digital optical fiber is used for isolation and transmission. Addition to data collection, the DSP controller calculates the duty cycle, which is based on the feedback signal, so that the output voltage can be real-timely traced and monitored. Consequently, the principle of whole system including control circuit and main circuit is described. Finally, the feasibility of the proposed approach is verified on a simulink model with 220V input and 4000V/1mA output. The results show that the HDC system meets the need of automatically detect electroosmosis experiment and gives full play to the convenience of digital power and control.

articleTitle: Data quality improvement method based on data correlation for power Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2019 12th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: In the current power Internet of Things, there are confusions in business data management, data models are not unified, and data loss problems are serious. Aiming at the problem of data loss, this paper proposes a new data quality improvement method for power IoT data The method divides the data into time-dependent sequence data and time-random sequence data depending on whether the data has relevance. According to the degree of data loss, the data is divided into severe missing data and a small amount of missing data. Finally, according to the divided data types, the data is complemented by the ARIMA model, the average interpolation method, etc. and the completed data sequence is obtained. After that, experiments were carried out using simulation data based on real data, and the reliability of the method was proved.

articleTitle: Grid Diagram Features for Automatic Pipa Fingering Technique Classification
publicationTitle: 2019 12th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Automatic classification on 7 typical playing techniques of Pipa is taken out in this paper. First, the Pipa spectrogram is normalized according to its fundamental frequency; then, 3 types of grid diagrams are generated from the normalized spectrogram; finally, different computation zones are assigned to the grid diagrams for feature extraction with their statistical values. In the automatic classification based on machine learning, with recognition accuracies up to 95.8% with very few number of features.

articleTitle: Evaluating Audio System Dynamic Range Performance under Variable Distortion Condition
publicationTitle: 2019 12th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Audio system performance evaluation plays a significant role not only for the product selection of users, but for validation of design specification. Among these parameters, dynamic range and spurious free dynamic range indexes are two of the most important portions. Spurious free dynamic range index only considers the highest harmonic or spurious while the dynamic range only consider the root mean square of the noise floor, and there is no evaluation method for the other part of the spectrum band width. In this paper, we proposed a universal method that evaluates the dynamic range performance of audio system corresponding to different allowable distortion degrees, which is called moving filtering line (MFL). The low complexity calculation method is realized by setting a MFL in the system output signal spectrum. Finally, we carried out simulation on MATLAB and performed experiments on a hardware platform, whose results verified its flexibility and effectiveness.

articleTitle: Study of Via Optimization Problem Based on Estimation of Distribution Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 12th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: optimizing the number of vias is an important approach for improving the performance and the yield of printed circuit boards (PCBs). To optimize the vias of multilayer PCBs, first, we converted the circuit routing diagram into an undirected weighted topology. Then, the mathematical model of the via optimization problem was established on the basis of the topological weight segmentation method. Finally, it was solved using estimation of distribution algorithm (EDA). Compared with the traditional methods, the proposed method was intuitive and easy to implement with no invalid solution existing in the intermediate process and with high operation efficiency. The simulation experiments demonstrated that the proposed algorithm could effectively solve the via optimization problem, and EDA had faster convergence and better effectiveness than the genetic algorithm (GA).

articleTitle: On the Genetic Regulation of Bayesian Networks
publicationTitle: 2019 12th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: To study the network regulatory relationship of genes, the probability knowledge and graph theory is combined by the Bayesian network method. The Bayesian network model of genes is constructed effectively and the reasoning is carried out. For a group of leukemia data, firstly, the data preprocessing such as standardization and discretization is carried out. Secondly, the order of the nodes between genes is obtained by the decision tree ID3 algorithm. And the structure learning of the Bayesian network is studied by the K2 algorithm to find out the network topology of genes. Then the parameter learning is used by the maximum likelihood estimation to find out the probability dependence relationship between the parent nodes and the child nodes in the network. Finally, the validity of the Bayesian network model is verified. The analysis of the test data shows that the Bayesian network has high accuracy to predict and analyse the regulatory relationship of genes.

articleTitle: The Design of High Efficient Battery Charging Circuit Based on STM32
publicationTitle: 2019 12th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: In the paper, introduce a high efficient battery charging circuit based on STM32F407. In general, charging circuit module controls output voltage by PWM chips which outputs square wave, and includes negative feedback circuit which can stable output voltage and output current. The charging circuit module is simple, and efficient, but the defect is clear that is the pure hardware circuit, if the output current or voltage needs change, the hardware circuit must be redesigned that is very difficult and inconvenient. In the paper, supply PWM on STM32F407, so that can efficiently control current and voltage in different situation, and needn't redesign hardware circuit. At the same time, with synchronous rectification technology and soft switching technology can design a high efficient battery charging circuit.

articleTitle: Position Measurement of the Hole Group Based on Point Cloud Registration Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 12th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: The position error of the hole group in a precision part directly affects the assembly quality. The accurate measurement of the position error for the hole group is the premise of judging whether the parts are qualified or not. In this paper, the central coordinates of the hole group are measured by the coordinate measuring machine, and the position of the hole group is evaluated based on the point cloud registration algorithm. The registration process is optimized for the possible problems of the experimental results. The experimental results show that the optimized point cloud registration algorithm is accurate and reliable, with high registration accuracy, and can accurately assess the position of the hole group.

articleTitle: Application of Rapid Modeling of Information Communication
publicationTitle: 2019 12th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Because society is constantly moving forward, some outdated technology will eventually be eliminated. On the one hand, we require the communication system to have powerful functions and better performance. On the other hand, it requires short time of product development and low cost control. So to meet these two ambivalent needs, it use computer technology to implement them. Simulation is necessary in the whole process of communication system engineering design. In the face of such problems, this paper proposes a fast modeling strategy for communication system based on MATLAB. Preliminary communication system modeling. The probability model and monte carlo method are introduced to realize the probability statistics method of simulation results. The simulation results can be processed by fitting and interpolation. Fast Fourier transform (FFT) technique is applied in OFDM communication system design. In addition, the model is evaluated by subjective evaluation and statistical test.Matlab/Simulink simulation experiment results in this paper show that the obtained data samples often have certain regularity, but also contain random perturbation, which may be caused by a variety of factors. Therefore, the curve with minimum error can be obtained by fitting and interpolation.

articleTitle: A Negatively Correlation-Based Selection Strategy for Parameter Adaptation in SHADE
publicationTitle: 2019 12th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Negatively correlated search (NCS) is a population-based metaheuristic algorithm inspired by human behaviors in cooperation. One of the main processes of NCS is to evaluate the Bhattacharyya distance of two generations of population and employ a “winner takes all” selection strategy to possess good exploitation ability. SHADE is an efficient variant of differential evolution algorithm which embedded a success-history based parameter adaptation strategy and demonstrates strong exploration capability. In this paper, a simple hybridization of NCS and SHADE is presented, which employs the negatively correlated method in the selection strategy of success parameters of SHADE. Due to the combination of advantages of both algorithms, the newly proposed NC-SHADE performs excellently on CEC'2017 benchmark function suit and has superiority in comparison with other related algorithms.

articleTitle: RLayout: Interior Design System Based on Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2019 12th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: The advanced artificial intelligence technologies have promoted the development of other industries. As a combination of AI technologies and art, intelligent design has become a research hotspot in recent years. Intelligent design uses computer to simulate human thinking activities with AI technologies, enabling the computers to undertake more complex design tasks in a better way. At the same time, reinforcement learning plays an increasingly important role in many fields, such as system control, game theory, computer network, decision making, etc. In this work, an intelligent design system based on the reinforcement learning algorithm was proposed, and corresponding reward rules were developed according to the design principles. The system can help the designer to generate the optimal scheme automatically, which can be extended and applied to find the best scheme in many problems, including interior design, daily schedule, resource arrangement, etc. Our demo shows that the system can offer excellent design scheme according to pre-set reward rules, and reduce workload of related designers.

articleTitle: Mixed Attention-Aware Network for Person Re-identification
publicationTitle: 2019 12th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a Mixed Attention-Aware Network (MAAN), which consists of a Partial Hard Attention (PHA) and an Attention-aware Feature Fusion Network (AFFN). PHA applies hard attention to the local feature map to eliminate irrelevant background and extract more finegrained human body features under the guidance of pose estimation. AFFN first applies soft attention to the global feature map, and then combines the local and global features with different attention-aware, and finally forms a mixed attention-aware feature to solve the pedestrian pose variations and severe occlusion problems. We perform two experiments on two large open source benchmarks, including Market-1501, CUHK03-NP. These verify our method achieve advanced result.

articleTitle: Algorithm of Mobile Communication Transmission Efficiency in Big Data
publicationTitle: 2019 12th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: With the change of information technology and the continuous expansion of data generated by the application of communication network, the communication network is optimized to improve the transmission rate and utilization rate of data. Through the research of this topic, students can master the corresponding control algorithm of mobile communication transmission efficiency, and complete the simulation and analysis of the control algorithm of mobile communication transmission efficiency under the background of large data based on MATLAB. The control algorithm of mobile communication transmission efficiency under large data is one of the methods to study the control algorithm of mobile communication transmission efficiency. Through the analysis of the problems of high throughput, slow convergence speed and low transmission efficiency in the control method of communication efficiency. Through simulation analysis, it can improve the application of communication transmission algorithm and channel characteristics. The simulation proves that the above problems can be solved by the application of communication transmission algorithm.

articleTitle: A Multi-Navigation Data Fusion Algorithm for Vehicle Localization in Airport
publicationTitle: 2019 12th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Precise and robust localization is an essential factor for the guidance of vehicles driving in the airport in low visibility operation. Ground Based Augmentation System (GBAS) solution can provide satisfactory positioning in open areas, however, its performance suffered in apron area due to the effects of multipath. In order to have safe and efficient localization for vehicles, a multi-navigation data fusion algorithm is employed by using Kullback-Leibler Divergence (KLD) metric, we show how to combine GBAS and other sensory information to acquire more reliable localization. Simulation results indicate the accuracy and robustness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: A Reactive Power Consumption Model of Inverter Station of LCC-HVDC Based on RBF Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2019 12th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Reactive power consumption of the modern power system is a very important problem that to solve well. Due to the line commutated current source converter-based (LCC) HVDC system is a multivariable and strong coupling nonlinear system, it is difficult to model reactive power consumption of receiving end of LCC-HVDC by traditional analysis method. This paper proposes the reactive power consumption model of receiving end of LCC-HVDC on account of the radial basis function (RBF) neural network. The model with the turn-off angle for input, with reactive power loss on the inverter side of LCC-HVDC for output, using 500kV, 1000MW LCC-HVDC system PSCAD simulation test data training RBF neural network and testing network generalization ability. The results indicate that the reactive power loss model on account of the RBF neural network has much faster convergence speed and higher convergence precision.

articleTitle: Application of Blockchain in IoT Data Trust and Information Available Technology
publicationTitle: 2019 12th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Due to the lack of flexible and effective processing mechanism in the process of data interaction and information transmission in Internet of Things(IoT), this has seriously hindered the process of realizing "interconnection of all things, sharing of all information " in IoT. In order to optimize the above problems, this paper introduces Blockchain technology, and focuses on the analysis of the mapping relationship of Blockchain technology for the hierarchical architecture of IoT. At the perception level of IoT, Merkle tree technology is used to realize the encryption and security of data; at the network level of IoT, the consensus mechanism for the correct use of the information is compared and analyzed. Based on the preliminary discussion of the application of the above Blockchain technology in IoT, the development trend of " IoT+Blockchain" technology in the future is conceived.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of VANET Authentication Architecture and Scheme
publicationTitle: 2019 12th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Vehicle Ad Hoc Network (VANET) is a kind of vehicular self-organizing network. The communication mode of VANET mainly includes V2V, V2I and I2V. VANET has the unique characteristics of changeable network topology, frequent exchange of messages between nodes and unstable channel resources. With the in-depth study of vehicular network, more and more security problems have emerged, and the safety of vehicular network is one of the important factors affecting the overall development of vehicular network. More and more scholars have studied and discussed this issue. This paper summarizes the research work on VANET security authentication in recent years. Firstly, an overview of the mathematical tools, cryptography basics, and cybersecurity knowledge used to build a secure authentication scheme; Then, several types of security authentication methods are introduced from the key technologies of authentication; Finally, it makes a comparative analysis of the existing work and summarizes the prospects.

articleTitle: An orthogonal mixed chaotic spread spectrum algorithm for satellite communication
publicationTitle: 2019 12th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: In this paper, an improved mixed orthogonal chaotic mapping algorithm was proposed to solve the problems of multi-path interference and increasing multi-access interference in satellite communication system. Meanwhile, a spread spectrum sequence generation algorithm mixed with different chaotic signals and normalized processing was proposed. The improved chaotic sequence of the phase-space method was used as an initial value to iterate into another chaotic sequence, and then the normalized transformation of Gram-Schmidt was carried out and quantified into a binary sequence. In addition, the simulation model of multi-channel chaotic spread spectrum communication system was established, and the chaos, balance and correlation of the improved chaotic sequence were analyzed, and then the bit error rates of different channels and different user numbers in the simulation system were compared. The simulation results proved that the sequence generated by the algorithm could improve the anti-multipath and multi-access interference capability of spread spectrum communication system, providing some reference for the design of spread spectrum sequence.

articleTitle: An Automatic Sleep Stage Classification Approach Based on Multi-Spike Supervised Learning
publicationTitle: 2019 12th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Sleep stage classification can provide important reference factors in enhancing diagnosis and treatment of sleep disorders and sleep-related diseases. However, such classification tasks based on polysomnography are more complicated. This article tried a novel approach to deal with the polysomnography data by using spiking neural networks, including a coding scheme for complex spatio-temporal data and a multi-spike supervised algorithm for training our neural network to implement the learning goal of spike trains. This automatic sleep stage recognition approach can be applied to solve polysomnography data multi-classification problem and avoid manual handling whenever possible. In the experiments, the effects of the different network parameters on the sleep stage classification accuracy are analyzed, and the final results indicate that the proposed approach can be used to assist sleep diagnosis.

articleTitle: An Optimization Model for Restructuring Distribution Network Considering Connecting Constraints of DGs
publicationTitle: 2019 12th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: This paper is to propose an optimization model for restructuring distribution network considering connecting constraints of DGs. First, problems of regional load improving and safe control of system contingency of distribution network connecting distributed generation were analyzed, and the basic concepts of returning current constraints and system contingency constraints of distributed generation were proposed. And then, two indexes of regional power total variable capacitance and 10kV feeder network structure qualification index were put forward. Subsequently, this paper proposed an optimization model for restructuring distribution network considering connecting constraints of DGs. Furthermore, an immune genetic algorithm (IGA) was proposed to solve this model. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed method was verified by simulation analysis of a practical 10 kV distribution network in a certain area.

articleTitle: Caching Strategy Based on Deep Q-Learning in Device-to-device Scenario
publicationTitle: 2019 12th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: With the explosive growth of multimedia data traffic represented by video-on-demand (VOD), the spectrum resource utilization of existing wireless networks is increasingly difficult to meet the needs. To solve this problem, device-to-device (D2D) technology is proposed in the 5th generation mobile communication (5G) standard. Relevant research has realized the offloading of video data in cellular network by introducing some auxiliary caching devices (helpers) in D2D network, so as to alleviate the pressure of base station and improve the utilization of spectrum. In this paper, we propose and experiment an algorithm to find the caching strategy of helpers based on deep reinforcement learning in D2D Scenario. And a structure of D2D auxiliary caching device is designed to apply the algorithm. The caching strategy generated by this algorithm can effectively guide the caching data settings in helpers. Experiments show that the VOD system based on the proposed algorithm has a higher utilization rate of bandwidth resources and lower base station load. Compared with random algorithm, the system cache hit rate and system offload rate increased by 12% and 16%, compared with FIFO algorithm, increased by 11% and 15%, and compared with LRU algorithm, increased by 4% and 6%.
